mapper.sql: membership_cards.id AS id, membership_cards.membership_type_id AS membershipTypeId, membership_card_types.name AS membershipTypeName, membership_card_types.color AS membershipTypeColor, membership_cards.customer_id AS customerId, customers.name AS customerName, customers.customer_code AS customerCode, membership_cards.card_id AS cardId, membership_cards.card_date_start AS cardDateStart, membership_cards.card_date_end AS cardDateEnd, membership_cards.current_point AS currentPoint, membership_cards.total_point AS totalPoint, membership_cards.point_expiration AS `period`, membership_cards.created AS created, CONCAT(IFNULL(creator.first_name, ''), ' ', IFNULL(creator.last_name, '')) AS createdBy, membership_cards.modified AS modified, CONCAT(IFNULL(modifier.first_name, ''), ' ', IFNULL(modifier.last_name, '')) AS modifiedBy

FROM membership_cards LEFT JOIN membership_card_types ON membership_card_types.id = membership_cards.membership_type_id LEFT JOIN customers ON customers.id = membership_cards.customer_id AND customers.is_active = 1 LEFT JOIN users AS creator ON membership_cards.created_by = creator.id LEFT JOIN users AS modifier ON membership_cards.modified_by = modifier.id

WHERE membership_cards.is_active = 1
AND ( membership_cards.card_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{filter.searchText}, '%') OR customers.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{filter.searchText}, '%') OR customers.customer_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{filter.searchText}, '%') OR membership_card_types.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{filter.searchText}, '%') )
mapper.select: SELECT id, membership_type_id AS membershipTypeId, customer_id AS customerId, current_point AS currentPoint, total_point AS totalPoint, point_expiration AS period FROM membership_cards WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} AND is_active = 1 LIMIT 1
SELECT id, amount, point, required_point AS requiredPoint FROM membership_card_types WHERE id = #{id} AND is_active = 1 LIMIT 1

SELECT id FROM membership_card_types WHERE is_active = 1 AND IFNULL(required_point, 0) <= #{totalPoint} AND IFNULL(required_point, 0) > ( SELECT IFNULL(required_point, 0) FROM membership_card_types WHERE id = #{membershipTypeId} LIMIT 1 ) ORDER BY IFNULL(required_point, 0) DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO membership_cards ( membership_type_id, customer_id, card_id, card_date_start, card_date_end, current_point, total_point, point_expiration, created, created_by, is_active ) VALUES ( #{membershipCard.membershipTypeId}, #{membershipCard.customerId}, #{membershipCard.cardId}, #{membershipCard.cardDateStart}, #{membershipCard.cardDateEnd}, #{membershipCard.currentPoint}, #{membershipCard.totalPoint}, #{membershipCard.period}, NOW(), #{membershipCard.createdBy}, #{membershipCard.isActive} )
mapper.update: UPDATE membership_cards SET membership_type_id = #{membershipCard.membershipTypeId}, customer_id = #{membershipCard.customerId}, card_id = #{membershipCard.cardId}, card_date_start = #{membershipCard.cardDateStart}, card_date_end = #{membershipCard.cardDateEnd}, current_point = #{membershipCard.currentPoint}, total_point = #{membershipCard.totalPoint}, point_expiration = #{membershipCard.period}, modified = NOW(), modified_by = #{membershipCard.modifiedBy} WHERE id = #{membershipCard.id} AND is_active = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO membership_card_logs ( membership_card_id, sales_order_id, total_amount, old_point, point, total_point, expired_date, created ) SELECT #{membershipCardId}, #{salesOrderId}, #{totalAmount}, #{oldPoint}, #{point}, #{totalPoint}, CASE WHEN membership_cards.point_expiration IS NOT NULL AND membership_cards.point_expiration > 0 THEN DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL membership_cards.point_expiration MONTH) ELSE NULL END, NOW() FROM membership_cards WHERE membership_cards.id = #{membershipCardId} AND membership_cards.is_active = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE membership_cards SET is_active = 2, modified = NOW(), modified_by = #{userId} WHERE id = #{id} AND is_active = 1
